firelight.options.title: Firelight
firelight.options.enabled.tooltip: Light from torches, lanterns, candles, campfires and fire flickers softly.
firelight.options.strength.tooltip: How much the light dips and flares. 100% is a gentle, natural flicker.
firelight.options.torches.tooltip: Torches, soul torches, copper torches and wall torches.
firelight.options.lanterns.tooltip: Lanterns and jack o'lanterns. Their glass keeps the flicker calm.
firelight.options.fires.tooltip: Campfires and burning fire flicker the most.
firelight.options.furnaces.tooltip: Lit furnaces, smokers and blast furnaces glow with a slow pulse.
firelight.options.entities.tooltip: Mobs, players and items near a flame flicker along with the ground.
firelight.options.reset.tooltip: Put every Firelight setting back to how it started.
